subject: Upcoming Team Building Event
body: Dear Team, I am excited to announce that we will be having a team building event next month at the local park. This will be a great opportunity for us to bond outside of work and engage in fun activities together. Please mark your calendars for the event on the 15th of next month. More details and the agenda will be shared with you soon. Looking forward to seeing you all there! Best regards, [Your Name]
